 AFCON 2027(Q): Babadi Kamara urges Leone Stars to keep fighting for DR Congo clash
 📅 November 17, 2026 
  • 
 👤 Kabuma Node 
  • 
 📁 AFCON 
  • 
 🕑 1 min read 
 𝐒𝐋𝐅𝐀 𝐏𝐫𝐞𝐬𝐢𝐝𝐞𝐧𝐭 𝐁𝐚𝐛𝐚𝐝𝐢 𝐊𝐚𝐦𝐚𝐫𝐚 has urged Leone Stars to remain 𝐝𝐞𝐭𝐞𝐫𝐦𝐢𝐧𝐞𝐝 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐧𝐞𝐯𝐞𝐫 𝐠𝐢𝐯𝐞 𝐮𝐩 as they prepare for Tuesday’s crucial encounter against the Leopards of DR Congo in the ongoing 𝐓𝐨𝐭𝐚𝐥𝐄𝐧𝐞𝐫𝐠𝐢𝐞𝐬 𝐂𝐀𝐅 𝐀𝐟𝐫𝐢𝐜𝐚 𝐂𝐮𝐩 𝐨𝐟 𝐍𝐚𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧𝐬 𝐊𝐄-𝐓𝐙-𝐔𝐆 𝟐𝟎𝟐𝟕 𝐐𝐮𝐚𝐥𝐢𝐟𝐢𝐞𝐫𝐬.
 President Kamara gave the motivational message during the team’s match situation training session at the 𝐒𝐭𝐚𝐝𝐞 𝐋𝐚𝐫𝐛𝐢 𝐙𝐚𝐨𝐮𝐥𝐢 𝐢𝐧 𝐂𝐚𝐬𝐚𝐛𝐥𝐚𝐧𝐜𝐚, 𝐌𝐨𝐫𝐨𝐜𝐜𝐨, ahead of Tuesday, November 17, 2026, fixture scheduled for 16:00 GMT.
 Addressing the players, he encouraged them to keep their heads up, put their previous results behind them and continue fighting until the final whistle, despite failing to secure a point from their opening three matches in the group.
 He reminded the players of the responsibility they carry 𝐭𝐨 𝐫𝐞𝐬𝐭𝐨𝐫𝐞 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐭𝐞𝐚𝐦 𝐭𝐨 𝐢𝐭𝐬 𝐰𝐢𝐧𝐧𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐰𝐚𝐲𝐬 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐛𝐫𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐬𝐦𝐢𝐥𝐞𝐬 𝐭𝐨 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐟𝐚𝐜𝐞𝐬 𝐨𝐟 𝐦𝐢𝐥𝐥𝐢𝐨𝐧𝐬 𝐨𝐟 𝐒𝐢𝐞𝐫𝐫𝐚 𝐋𝐞𝐨𝐧𝐞𝐚𝐧𝐬 𝐛𝐚𝐜𝐤 𝐡𝐨𝐦𝐞.
 The SLFA President further challenged the squad to approach the upcoming fixture with renewed determination, commitment and belief, urging every player to give their absolute best as the team seeks to turn its fortunes around.
